data.title: Waves
data.statement:
Given a word [[word]] consisting of lowercase English letters ({{a}} - {{z}}), pull the letters apart vertically such that:

• Two adjacent characters in the original [[word]] remain horizontally adjacent.
• The vertical height of a character is <<one lower / the same / one higher>> relative to the character on its direct left, depending on whether its ASCII value (relative to the character on its direct left) is <<lower / the same / higher>>.

Fill gaps in the 2D grid with spaces. Watch the letters rise and fall!

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given a word word consisting of lowercase English letters (a - z), pull the letters apart vertically such that:

• Two adjacent characters in the original word remain horizontally adjacent.
• The vertical height of a character is one lower / the same / one higher relative to the character on its direct left, depending on whether its ASCII value (relative to the character on its direct left) is lower / the same / higher.

Fill gaps in the 2D grid with spaces. Watch the letters rise and fall!
Input
Line 1: A positive integer n; the number of characters in word.
Line 2: The input word.
Output
n columns of spaces and lowercase English characters, based on the rules stated above. Each row should be stripped of trailing spaces.
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 30
Example
Input
5
wrong
Output
w
 r
  o
   n
    g
